notes.title: NEKOPARA x Makeship Campaign Vol. 3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578425/7c48945684a737f95c608c9b25abc863fcb428af.png"][/img][/p][p]We're excited to be teaming up with Makeship again and this time around the spotlight is on Maple and Cinnamon![/p][p]Both campaigns got started a couple days ago and are already nearing the 60% funding mark. There's still plenty of time to get in on these campaigns as they will run till [b]August 15, 9:00 AM PDT[/b]. Don't miss out![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/sayori" style="button"]Preorder here![/url][/p]

notes.title: NEKOPARA After is Coming Out Tomorrow Morning!
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone for your patience! NEKOPARA After is releasing in less than 24 hours. Get it with a 10% discount for the next two weeks. Just in time for summer~[/p][p][/p][p]With the ongoing Steam Summer Sale, now's the time to get the entire series if you haven't already done so![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/676/NEKOPARA/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Delay Announcement
notes.content: The release date of Nekopara After release has been pushed back to TBD while we wait on 3rd party approvals, please look forward to the newest installment set in Hawaii!
